title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Atelier Note on Personalised Pairs and the Remake Set-Off
content:
When a cancelled Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order pair is remade, the set-off of its work charge against the remake deposit is multiplied according to the pair's personalisation and how long it was in production before it was cancelled:

1. by **1.2** when the cancelled pair was personalised and was cancelled 7 days or more after its production started;
2. by **1.1** when it was personalised and was cancelled sooner;
3. by **1.0** when it carried no personalisation.

The pair was personalised if its reservation records a personalisation. The days run from the pair's production start date to the cancellation date on its record, in calendar days: the start day is not counted and the cancellation day is.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical pairs)**

| Personalisation on the pair | Production start | Cancelled | Days | Set-off multiplied by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| "ELLA" | 4 March | 11 March | 7 | 1.2 |
| "ELLA" | 4 March | 10 March | 6 | 1.1 |
| None | 4 March | 30 March | 26 | 1.0 |

A set-off of $60.00 on a personalised pair cancelled 7 or more days into production therefore becomes $72.00. On a personalised pair cancelled sooner it becomes $66.00.
